title: Label risk-relevant third-party vendors in the corpus and report vendor precision and recall (DATAP-789, DATAP-895)

comments.author: home
comments.text: Labels for 37 packets and the vendor report are committed. Corpus: 234 vendors, recall 26.9% at labelled provenance, precision 90.4%. Misses: 98 raw HTTP, 70 no SDK mapping, 3 provenance wrong. medusa, posthog-user and yjdh-employee could not be materialized and have no labels.
